verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Disputes API that can retrieve dispute information, defend or accept disputes, and upload defense documents. An agent could use it to fetch disputes and submit evidence the merchant has reviewed. The pack also documents general webhooks that replace polling, but none of the evidence ties them to dispute events or deadlines, and nothing covers drafting evidence for review. missing for 10: documented dispute-specific webhooks or deadline/due-date fields for monitoring, any draft or review workflow for evidence responses, dispute tooling in the MCP server, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor dispute deadlines via API or webhooks and draft evidence responses for my review

citations.quote: You can retrieve dispute information, defend or accept disputes, and upload defense documents.
With webhooks, you can avoid having to continuously poll an API endpoint, waiting for a change in status for an asynchronous process
